# VN13 / VN-13

Last reviewed: 2026-09-25

> VN13 is a fashion distribution platform and the team behind VN-13, an independent womenswear brand focused on designer collections, European brands, capsule production, wholesale partnerships, and controlled distribution for boutiques and showrooms.

VN13 helps clients, boutiques, showrooms, and fashion brands discover, distribute, and develop premium womenswear.

Primary site: https://vn-13.com/
Contact: info@vn-13.com

- [Telegram](https://t.me/vn13agency)

## Verified brand sources

- [Moyuru official website](https://www.moyuru.com/)

## Core positioning

- VN13: European fashion distribution, brand representation, pre-order programs, retail partnerships, wholesale womenswear for boutiques.
- VN-13: own womenswear brand, designer women's clothing, premium women's clothing, capsule collections, limited production, womenswear manufacturing.
- Markets: Russia, CIS countries, Europe.
- Languages: Russian, English, French, Italian, German.
- Buyer intent: wholesale womenswear supplier, boutique assortment selection, showroom clothing, fashion buyer support.
- Japanese style context: VN13 presents Moyuru as a Japanese designer womenswear brand; the related guide covers contemporary Japanese style, designer minimalism, Japanese avant-garde, layering, free silhouettes, and wearable outfit building.
